name: A Strange Red Key
label: Quest
description: A Strange Red Key: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The small red key seems to be made of some kind of bone material. It is heavy in your hand, but appears very fragile. Why would a member of the Shadow Council have such a thing? Perhaps there is something within Jaedenar that this strange key unlocks.

clips.title: Progress
paras: I begin to wonder if I'll ever escape this cage.
It's only a matter of time before they sacrifice me to whatever demons they worship. The monsters!

clips.title: Completion
paras: The key, you've found it! Please, give it to me and I can finally escape!
